title: Kaydanch Mar Gayi Ha Ay Rondi Sakina Kis
body:
QAIDAN CH MARGAYI HAYE RONDI SAKINA KISAY SUNIYA NA DOHAYAIAN
MAZLOOM DI DHI NU KHA GAYI AAN ZINDAAN DIYAN TANHAYIAN
<<DIVIDER>>
BAAZAR CH SYEDAN TAY BARSAAT HUEE PATHARAN DI
HAYE ZAHRA JAYIAN TAY SIR KHAAK PAYI SAFRAAN DI
KI GHARIYAN AUKHIAN AYIAAN
<<DIVIDER>>
KADI PUCDHI HAI PHUPIYAN TON KIOON ZULM KERAY ITAY LOKI
AU RASM AI SHAAMIYAN DI JAY PATHAR MARAY ITAY LOKI
ASAAN UJRIYAN TON KERHA KHATRA KION MAL LAY MOR SIPHAYIAN
<<DIVIDER>>
CHALI JANJ ALI AKBAR DI KUCH BAAL TAY KUCH MASTOORAN
SIR ZAKHMI JAANJIYAN DE ZAKHMAN TAY JAMIYAN DHOOLAN
LARAY DA SIR AI SAANG UTAY RASIYAN PHUPHIYAN PAYIAN
<<DIVIDER>>
ZINDAAN DE ANDHERON TON MASOOM SAKINA DAR GAYI
AKHTAR JERHI RONDI SI CHUP GAYI
CHEHRE DAY DAAGH DISDAIN HIN AI KON SHIMR CHAPAIRAAN LAYIAN
